endpoints.reach: McCreery River Access to Stone Cliff
endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: wv_nps_mccreery_new_river_access_20260919 nps-mccreery-new-river-access: NPS New River Gorge fishing guidance lists McCreery among public New River access points off Hwy. 41 near Prince. NPS public assembly material separately identifies a McCreery River Access site and its parking/meeting footprint. Retain the stored route point as the McCreery access-area anchor; the 522-foot named-flowline offset reflects the gorge road/parking facility placement rather than a wrong access coordinate.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (wv_nps_mccreery_new_river_access_20260919 nps-mccreery-new-river-access) on New River; access is conditional (Confirm current NPS road condition, parking, carry/ramp route, river level, and any seasonal or safety restrictions at arrival.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.

endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: wv_wvdnr_stone_cliff_new_river_access_20260919 wvdnr-stone-cliff-new-river-access: West Virginia DNR District 4 access table lists Stone Cliff in Fayette County on the New River with a parking lot and boat access at 37.9337,-81.0639. NPS identifies Stone Cliff as a public New River access near Thurmond. Retain the stored endpoint as the access-area anchor; its 274-foot offset from the published DNR point and 379-foot named-flowline distance reflect the gorge access road and facility placement.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (wv_wvdnr_stone_cliff_new_river_access_20260919 wvdnr-stone-cliff-new-river-access) on New River; access is conditional (Confirm current NPS/WVDNR road, parking, ramp, and carry conditions at arrival; gorge roads and river access can be seasonal or weather-affected.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.
